message.content:
{
  "schema_version": "structured_v1_icaira",
  "criterion_comparisons": [
    {
      "pair_id": "C1_C2",
      "criterion_a": "C1",
      "criterion_b": "C2",
      "preferred": "C1",
      "intensity": "strong",
      "reason": "Annualized TCO creates a traceable multi-year cost burden; expected hours released are less directly realizable."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C3_C5",
      "criterion_a": "C3",
      "criterion_b": "C5",
      "preferred": "C3",
      "intensity": "strong",
      "reason": "Lower production effort preserves scarce delivery bandwidth and reduces execution exposure; throughput matters only after successful deployment."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C2_C4",
      "criterion_a": "C2",
      "criterion_b": "C4",
      "preferred": "C4",
      "intensity": "strong",
      "reason": "Avoiding probability-weighted compliance losses protects audit obligations and downside exposure more directly than projected time savings."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C1_C6",
      "criterion_a": "C1",
      "criterion_b": "C6",
      "preferred": "C1",
      "intensity": "very_strong",
      "reason": "Recurring platform cost materially shapes capital allocation and earnings; user training time is a narrower implementation concern."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C4_C5",
      "criterion_a": "C4",
      "criterion_b": "C5",
      "preferred": "C4",
      "intensity": "very_strong",
      "reason": "Compliance exposure can create financial and audit consequences; throughput is primarily an operating-capacity consideration."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C2_C3",
      "criterion_a": "C2",
      "criterion_b": "C3",
      "preferred": "C2",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "Recurring released capacity supports the business case across multiple years, outweighing one-time production-readiness effort."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C1_C4",
      "criterion_a": "C1",
      "criterion_b": "C4",
      "preferred": "C1",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "Both are annual financial exposures, but TCO is certain and persistent while compliance loss is probability-weighted."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C5_C6",
      "criterion_a": "C5",
      "criterion_b": "C6",
      "preferred": "C6",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "User proficiency more directly determines whether organization-wide benefits are realized, while throughput remains an enabling capacity."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C3_C4",
      "criterion_a": "C3",
      "criterion_b": "C4",
      "preferred": "C4",
      "intensity": "strong",
      "reason": "Compliance losses threaten controls, reporting obligations and audit outcomes; integration effort is a bounded readiness cost."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C2_C6",
      "criterion_a": "C2",
      "criterion_b": "C6",
      "preferred": "C2",
      "intensity": "strong",
      "reason": "Annual productivity benefit is the core economic outcome; onboarding time is an adoption cost affecting realization."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C1_C5",
      "criterion_a": "C1",
      "criterion_b": "C5",
      "preferred": "C1",
      "intensity": "very_strong",
      "reason": "TCO directly affects funding capacity and recurring results; throughput has a less direct financial consequence."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C4_C6",
      "criterion_a": "C4",
      "criterion_b": "C6",
      "preferred": "C4",
      "intensity": "very_strong",
      "reason": "Data and compliance losses affect the control environment and external obligations; proficiency time mainly affects rollout efficiency."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C2_C5",
      "criterion_a": "C2",
      "criterion_b": "C5",
      "preferred": "C2",
      "intensity": "strong",
      "reason": "Released work capacity is the business outcome supporting the case; throughput is an enabling technical capability."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C1_C3",
      "criterion_a": "C1",
      "criterion_b": "C3",
      "preferred": "C1",
      "intensity": "strong",
      "reason": "Annualized TCO affects the full evaluation horizon and capital plan; integration effort is concentrated before production."
    },
    {
      "pair_id": "C3_C6",
      "criterion_a": "C3",
      "criterion_b": "C6",
      "preferred": "C3",
      "intensity": "moderate",
      "reason": "Production-readiness effort creates immediate execution and resource pressure; onboarding time follows only after a viable deployment."
    }
  ],
  "declared_priority_order": [
    "C1",
    "C4",
    "C2"
  ]
}
